verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a compliance SaaS could plausibly offer in-product AI insights, but nothing in the pack documents AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Drata. The MCP server and the 'enable AI agents to interact with Drata' material describe external agents connecting to Drata, which belongs to a different story and earns no credit here. The Risk Assessment and Trust Center Analytics Dashboard items do not mention AI-generated insights.
